text: 🇲🇽⚓ Navy: drug traffic has shifted to the Pacific — 80 tons seized at sea. "Most of the drugs are now concentrated in the Pacific, so our deployment is toward the South Pacific and the Eastern Pacific... this gives us early warning to seize vessels mainly loaded with drugs." — Adm. Raymundo Morales Ángeles, Navy Secretary Around 80 tons have been seized at sea, mainly from CJNG and Sinaloa cartel shipments. The Navy is also guarding ports against stowaways who throw cargo overboard for pickup crews.
banner: NAVY: 80 TONS SEIZED IN THE PACIFIC

text: 🇲🇽✊ "It is the nation's bank — a bank of the people of Mexico." "All Welfare Programs — one trillion pesos this year — go through the Banco del Bienestar. Every beneficiary has an account... It is a bank of the nation, a bank of the people of Mexico." — President Claudia Sheinbaum Fitch gave the state bank a high rating, citing sound management and the social programs it channels. The bank is expanding digital payments so beneficiaries can pay by card without cash.
banner: "A BANK OF THE PEOPLE OF MEXICO"

text: 🇲🇽✈️ "It's the cheapest airline in the whole country." "Rescuing Mexicana de Aviación was very important... People are very happy flying Mexicana. And it's also the cheapest airline in the whole country." — President Claudia Sheinbaum Mexicana added 5 destinations from AIFA (Acapulco, Tuxtla Gutiérrez, Chihuahua, Hermosillo, Guanajuato). The fleet will reach 20 Embraer jets — 7 more this year, the final 8 next year.
banner: MEXICANA: 20 JETS, CHEAPEST FARES IN MX

text: 🇲🇽🌎 "May fraternity always be Mexico's seal." "May solidarity always be what reflects our country. May fraternity always be Mexico's seal." — President Claudia Sheinbaum Ontario's premier publicly thanked Mexico for sending 100 firefighters to battle Canada's wildfires. Sheinbaum noted Mexico also sent crews to California and Texas — and two more Navy ships depart today with aid for earthquake-hit Venezuela.

🇲🇽🌎 "Those who plan, execute and develop the operation were Mexican authorities." "There is information exchange with respect for sovereignty... In the operation against Nemesio Oseguera — planned, developed, executed by the Mexican Army — there was information exchange with US agencies, but those who plan, execute and develop the operation were Mexican authorities." — Omar García Harfuch, Security Secretary Asked about the US ambassador's remarks on joint operations, Harfuch confirmed permanent cooperation while stressing who commands on the ground: Mexican Special Forces, Air Force and National Guard.

🇲🇽🔍 "He knew of the homicide — not that he ordered it. The one who ordered it was 'R1'." "There are indications that Nemesio Oseguera also knew about this crime... The indications we have, from two testimonies and judge-authorized wiretaps, are that he knew of the homicide — not that he ordered it." — Omar García Harfuch, Security Secretary Harfuch revealed the CJNG leader's alleged knowledge of the Carlos Manzo murder after the capture of "El R1", the accused intellectual author. He stressed the indication is not yet fully solid.
banner: MENCHO KNEW OF MANZO KILLING: SSPC

text: 🇲🇽🔍 31 arrested — "There will be no impunity in this case, or in any other." "The President's instruction when she went to Uruapan — that there would be no impunity — has been fulfilled. And there are 31 detainees to prove there will be no impunity in this case, or in any other." — Omar García Harfuch, Security Secretary Ramón Ángel "N", "El R1" — the CJNG cell leader accused of ordering and financing the Nov 1, 2025 murder of Uruapan mayor Carlos Manzo — was arrested yesterday in Atotonilco el Alto, Jalisco. All 31 people detained in the case have been charged.
banner: "NO IMPUNITY IN THIS CASE, OR IN ANY OTHER"

text:
🇲🇽🏦 <u>HACIENDA FLUNKS 3 BANKS IN PERFORMANCE REVIEW</u>

Mexico’s SHCP evaluated 49 multiple banking institutions: 46 passed, three got a flat "no satisfactorio" — Bancrea, Credit Suisse México and Shinhan de México — and must now correct their deficiencies under supervision. Four more banks left with formal observations.

The regulator is regulating.
